test_title: PYST 7: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct option to rearrange the following sentences:

A. Every theory he proposed was dismissed as radical.

B. But centuries later, his equations solved modern problems.

C. He died penniless, never knowing his genius was real.

D. Time sometimes takes too long to apologize.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph describes a progression of events related to a historical figure who was unrecognized in his time but gained recognition posthumously.
 
• **Sentence A is the first sentence** because it introduces the subject, emphasizing how every theory he proposed was dismissed as radical:
 
 
• "Every theory he proposed was dismissed as radical."
 
 
 
• **Sentence C follows** as it continues the narrative about his life and how he died unrecognized:
 
 
• "He died penniless, never knowing his genius was real."
 
 
 
• **Sentence B comes next** as it describes how his contributions were recognized later on:
 
 
• "But centuries later, his equations solved modern problems."
 
 
 
• **Sentence D concludes** the paragraph with a reflective statement that ties the story together:
 
 
• "Time sometimes takes too long to apologize."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **ACBD**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Every theory he proposed was dismissed as radical. He died penniless, never knowing his genius was real. But centuries later, his equations solved modern problems. Time sometimes takes too long to apologize."</div
